steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_is_tc_parent (id INT NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_code (code)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE p0_is_tc_child (cid INT NOT NULL, seq INT NOT NULL, parent_id INT NULL, label VARCHAR(64), PRIMARY KEY (cid, seq), KEY idx_label (label), UNIQUE KEY uk_pair (parent_id, seq), CONSTRAINT fk_child_parent FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES p0_is_tc_parent (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE p0_is_tc_plain (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL, other_code VARCHAR(32) NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_plain_default FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES p0_is_tc_parent (id), CONSTRAINT fk_plain_restrict FOREIGN KEY (other_code) REFERENCES p0_is_tc_parent (code) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE NO ACTION) ENGINE=InnoDB

SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE, ENFORCED FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME

SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, CONSTRAINT_NAME, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME, MATCH_OPTION, UPDATE_RULE, DELETE_RULE, TABLE_NAME, REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME
